Name: Zoomy Farmer
Author: GekoX
Description:
[size=6]Stardew Valley 1.6 supported![/size]

This mod adds lets the farmer sprint, at the cost of stamina. Additionally, floor tiles can be used to add additional speed, turning your paths into roads.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Hold down the sprint button (Left Control by default) and zoom!

[size=5]Config[/size]
[code]sprintSpeed*[/code]: What speed to move at when sprinting. Normal run speed is 5. Default is 7.
[code]staminaDrainPerSecond*[/code]: How much stamina to drain per each second of sprinting. Default is 1.
[code]enableStaminaDrain*[/code]: If stamina is used when sprinting. Defaults to true.
[code]fasterOnFloorTiles*[/code]: Adds a slight speed increase if sprinting on floor tiles. Default is true.
[code]additionalFloorSpeed*[/code]: How much to increase the sprint speed by when sprinting on floor tiles and fasterOnFloorTiles is enabled. Default is 1.

[code]sprintKey[/code]: The key to hold to sprint. Default is LeftControl.
[code]alternateSprintKey[/code]: An alternate key to use to sprint. Default is LeftStick.
[code]toggleSprint[/code]: Enables toggle sprint. Default is true (press to start/stop sprint).
[code]enableSprintWhenWaking[/code]: Automatically sprints when getting out of bed. This only works when togglesprint is enabled. Default is true.

[code]multiplayerSync[/code]: Sync the host's config to the clients. Default is true. This only needs to be set on the host, and only the starred(*) config values are sent.

[b]NOTE: Setting either of the sprint keys to the same keybind as [code]run[/code]can cause unintended behavior![/b]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows. Untested on Android.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer (online, split screen, or both). Host configs can be enforced to all connected players.
[*]Works with both keyboard/mouse and a gamepad by default.
[/list]
